name: larena/core
description: Larena Core package: platform contracts, operation runtime, package registry and shared foundation.

scripts.validate:larena: php -r 'foreach (["module.yaml", "config/larena-core.php", "src/Contracts/OperationRuntime.php", "src/Contracts/OperationDescriptor.php", "src/Contracts/OperationContext.php", "src/Contracts/OperationResult.php", "src/Contracts/OperationDecision.php", "src/Enums/OperationExecutionMode.php", "src/Enums/OperationDecisionStatus.php"] as $file) { if (!is_file($file)) { fwrite(STDERR, "Missing {$file}\n"); exit(1); } } echo "Larena core contract skeleton is valid.\n";'
